description.summary: privileged agent protocol (COMP-08)

protocol.description:
Served only on the privileged agent socket, $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/eclipse/ec-agent.sock (COMP-08 preamble, F-06), and only while the `agents` add-on hook is on (ADR 0069). A client of the public wayland-N socket never sees these globals (C-00 §8.1).
The sole intended client is agentd. Every eclipse_agent_v1 object speaks for exactly one agent principal, bound by the signed grant it was created with.
This is the M14 subset (COMP-16): admission, the read-only scene queries list_toplevels, get_toplevel, hit_test and wait_for (M11, M14), and the per-agent virtual seat eclipse_agent_seat_v1 with its acting requests (M13) and, from version 3 (M14), atomic batches, expected_generation checks, request dedupe, compat locks and action.

description.summary: creates agent objects from signed grants (COMP-08 §1)

entry.name: invalid_grant
entry.summary: the grant failed signature, expiry or principal checks

entry.name: policy_unavailable
entry.summary: policyd is not connected; no grant can be verified (COMP-01 §6)

request.name: create_agent

description.summary: admit one agent

request.description: grant is a COSE_Sign1 CBOR grant signed by policyd (S-01 §4). The compositor verifies signature, expiry and principal. Failure is the protocol error invalid_grant, or policy_unavailable while policyd is not connected.

description.summary: release the manager; agent objects are unaffected
policyd revoked a principal (informational to agentd)
how long (agent, req_id) results are kept (COMP-08 §2.2)
one agent principal (COMP-08 §2)

entry.name: invalid_grant
entry.summary: add_grant: the grant failed verification or names another principal

entry.name: seat_exists
entry.summary: get_seat: this agent already has a seat

description.summary: result.status, shared by every interface (COMP-08 §2.1)
the perception interface (COMP-08 §3)

request.name: get_seat

description.summary: this agent's virtual seat (COMP-08 §4, COMP-04 §3)

request.description: One seat per agent, created on the first call. A second get_seat on the same agent object is the protocol error seat_exists. The seat is a wl_seat named "agent-N" on the public display, so the clients it acts on receive its events; it holds no compositor bindings. Every request on it goes through the enforcement order (COMP-08 §10).

request.name: add_grant

description.summary: an additional signed grant for the same principal

request.description: Failure is the protocol error invalid_grant, or policy_unavailable while policyd is not connected.

description.summary: revokes everything this object holds

event.name: result

description.summary: the outcome of a request that produced no data event

event.description: status is an eclipse_agent_v1.status value. focus_handle, generation and latency_us are what the seat's own result carries (see eclipse_agent_seat_v1.result); this event reports 0 for them.

interface.name: eclipse_scene_v1

description.summary: read-only scene queries (COMP-08 §3)

interface.description:
Every response is filtered to the agent's scene.list scope and sensitivity class. A handle the agent cannot see, whether out of scope, no-agent or never existed, is answered exactly like an unknown one: result status invalid_argument, detail "handle" (F-07).
A successful query ends in its data event (toplevels_done, toplevel_detail, hit); a refused one ends in exactly one result event instead. The provenance event (M12) is not sent yet.
generation is the toplevel's generation (COMP-08 §3): a counter that changes whenever what an agent could act on changes (app_id, title, geometry, workspace, output, maximized, fullscreen, floating, minimized). It is never reused and never 0. Until the semantic tree exists (COMP-09) the counter tracks those facts, not tree contents.
Fields not yet backed by compositor state carry placeholders: semantic, app_trust and parent are 0, launched_by_self is 0.

request.name: list_toplevels

description.summary: every toplevel that exists for this agent

request.description: filter is a KDL filter in the S-01 §3 scope grammar. Only the empty string is accepted at M11; anything else is invalid_argument with detail "filter".

description.summary: one toplevel, in detail (needs scene.read)

event.name: toplevel_detail

description.summary: get_toplevel's answer, after a toplevel event

event.description: get_toplevel answers with a toplevel event carrying the same req_id, then this event with what scene.read adds (one event cannot carry both: libwayland caps an event at 20 arguments). popups is an array of native-endian u32 handles. focused_by_seats is a list of seat names, each NUL-terminated.

request.name: hit_test

description.summary: what a click at (x, y) would hit (needs scene.read)

request.description: Global logical coordinates. When the topmost thing at the point is not a toplevel this agent can see, hit carries handle 0.

request.name: wait_for

description.summary: wait until a predicate holds (COMP-08 §3)

request.description:
predicate is one KDL node: toplevel_appears app_id="x" title="y" (either or both), title_matches handle=N regex="re", focus seat="human|agent-N" handle=N, generation_gt handle=N n=G, unmapped handle=N, idle handle=N ms=M (the toplevel's generation has not changed for M ms). node, text_contains, node_gone and command_finished need the semantic tree or a terminal channel and are invalid_argument "unsupported". An unparsable predicate is invalid_argument "predicate"; a handle the agent cannot see is invalid_argument "handle". timeout_ms is 1 to 600000.
The answer is one waited event. A refused request ends in a result event instead, and so does a duplicate req_id among live waits.

request.name: cancel_wait

description.summary: drop a pending wait_for

request.description: req_id names the wait_for. The wait ends with waited satisfied 0. A req_id with no pending wait is a result with invalid_argument "req_id".

event.name: waited

description.summary: a wait_for ended (COMP-08 §3)

event.description: satisfied is 1 when the predicate held, 0 on timeout or cancel. generation is the toplevel's generation at satisfaction, not at request time and not at delivery (P-07 §5.3). handle is the toplevel the predicate was satisfied by (0 when none). node is 0 until the semantic tree exists.

description.summary: same shape and status values as eclipse_agent_v1.result

interface.name: eclipse_agent_seat_v1

description.summary: one agent's virtual seat (COMP-08 §4)

interface.description:
Acting requests. Each is checked in the COMP-08 §10 order, runs on this agent's seat only, and ends in exactly one result event carrying its req_id (possibly later, when a prompt or a deferral is pending). Every acting request ends with provenance_ids (COMP-08 §4.1): a CBOR array of chain_ids the agent asserts as inputs. The empty array is legal and means "no asserted inputs"; it does not mean trusted.
Every acting request also takes batch_token (0 means none) just before provenance_ids.
Key and text content is never logged.
expected_generation (focus, text, click, action) is a toplevel generation as the scene reported it. 0 means unchecked. Otherwise, after the policy decision and before anything runs (COMP-08 §10 step 8), a different current generation is stale_generation with the current one as detail and nothing is done.
Every request carries a req_id, unique per agent within the dedupe window (the manager's dedupe_window event, COMP-08 §2.2). A repeated req_id gets one result with status duplicate and detail "status" or "status:detail" of the original; nothing runs again. A request that is still waiting on a prompt answers duplicate with detail "pending".
Atomic batches (COMP-04 §4): begin_atomic opens a batch; acting requests that follow are queued, not run, and answer when the batch ends. commit_atomic checks every queued step and runs them in order with no human input between them. A target that is gone or unmapped, a seat focus that was lost, a stale generation or a pause aborts the whole batch before any step runs: every queued request and the commit answer with the cause (focus_lost, stale_generation, paused) and nothing was applied.

description.summary: keyboard focus on a toplevel (seat.focus)

request.name: key

description.summary: one key event on this seat (seat.key)

request.description: keycode is an evdev code. state is 1 pressed, 0 released. mods is reserved and ignored: press the modifier keys explicitly.

request.name: keysym

description.summary: a key by keysym, mapped via the seat keymap (seat.key)

request.description: May emit several keycodes (a shift modifier plus the key). A keysym the keymap cannot produce is invalid_argument.

request.name: text

description.summary: type a string into the focused field (seat.text)

request.description: result.detail is "text_input" when the string was committed through text_input_v3, "keysym" when it was typed as a keysym sequence, and the request is invalid_argument with detail "unsupported" when neither path can produce it. handle must name the window the seat has focus on, or be 0.

description.summary: move this seat's pointer, global logical coordinates (seat.pointer)
move this seat's pointer by a delta (seat.pointer)

request.name: button

description.summary: a pointer button (seat.pointer)

request.description: button is an evdev code. state is 1 pressed, 0 released.

request.name: axis

description.summary: a scroll event (seat.pointer)

request.description: axis is wl_pointer.axis (0 vertical, 1 horizontal), source is wl_pointer.axis_source.

request.name: click

description.summary: focus, move to a point, press and release (click)

request.description: The click lands at (x, y) in global logical coordinates (COMP-08 §4, node 0). handle names the window it must land on (0: whichever is topmost and visible there). A nonzero node needs the semantic tree (COMP-09) and is invalid_argument "node" until it exists.

request.name: begin_atomic

description.summary: open an atomic batch (COMP-04 §4, needs seat.atomic)

request.description: max_frames is how many frames the batch may take to deliver (1 to 60; 0 means the default, 4). An open batch that is not committed within 5 seconds is abandoned. A second begin_atomic while one is open is invalid_argument "nested".

request.name: commit_atomic

description.summary: run the queued steps, all or none

request.description: Answers ok with the number of steps run as detail, or the cause that aborted the batch. With no open batch: invalid_argument "no_batch".

request.name: abort_atomic

description.summary: discard the open batch

request.description: Every queued request answers invalid_argument "aborted"; nothing ran.

request.name: action

description.summary: a semantic action on a node (COMP-08 §4, COMP-09 §4)

request.description: Needs seat.action and the semantic tree, which does not exist yet (COMP-09): every action is no_such_action.

request.name: compat_lock

description.summary: exclusive lock on a seat-compat lock toplevel (COMP-04 §7)

request.description: Needs seat.compat_lock and seat.focus on the window, and the window must carry seat-compat lock (X11 windows always do), else invalid_argument "not_compat". While held, the human's keys, buttons and scrolls for that window are queued and delivered in order on release. timeout_ms is the lock's lifetime (1 to 60000; 0 means 10000). One lock per window: another agent's lock is quota_exceeded "compat_lock". Released by compat_unlock, expiry, pause, or the seat going away.

request.name: compat_unlock

description.summary: release this agent's compat lock

request.description: With no lock held: invalid_argument "no_lock".

request.name: preflight

description.summary: ask the human to approve a batch of targets up front (COMP-08 §4.2)

request.description: taxonomy_id names the action class. handles and nodes are CBOR arrays of uint, of equal length, zipped into (handle, node) targets; at most 1000. Bad CBOR, unequal lengths or too many targets is invalid_argument. The answer is a result, and on approval a batch_token event.

description.summary: releases the seat: held keys are released and the wl_seat goes away
same shape and status values as eclipse_agent_v1.result

event.name: batch_token

description.summary: a preflight was approved (COMP-08 §4.2)

event.description: Present token as batch_token on the acting requests it covers. covered is how many targets it covers; expires_ms is absolute.

description.summary: this seat's keyboard focus moved (generation is the toplevel's)
the seat's active keymap (xkb_v1 text), sent on creation
